scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm --silent --filter @idemantis/runner run dev
scripts.proof:faults: pnpm --silent --filter @idemantis/fault-suite... run build && pnpm --silent --filter @idemantis/fault-suite run proof
scripts.proof:agents: pnpm --silent --filter @idemantis/benchmark... run build && pnpm --silent --filter @idemantis/benchmark run proof
scripts.reference: pnpm run build && pnpm --silent --filter @idemantis/runner run reference
